secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.description: Google Workspace account used to authenticate the SMTP fallback (ksykes@heartenhome.org). Only needed if the Base44 SendEmail integration is unavailable; must match CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL or an alias.

secrets.name: SMTP_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Google Workspace App Password for SMTP_USERNAME (requires 2-Step Verification; generated at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Revocable — your Google password is never used.
